root.help:
one — workspace development

USAGE
  one <command> [options]

EVERYDAY COMMANDS
  create        Create a workspace
  add           Add a project
  run           List and execute workspace tasks
  exec          Execute a command with project variables
  env           Manage environment variables
  login         Sign in to Infisical in your browser

COMMON OPTIONS
  -o, --output  Output format: json | yaml | text
  -h, --help    Show help
  -v, --version Show version

EXAMPLES
  one create demo
  one add
  one dev
  one build -p web
  one test -p web

All commands: one help --all
Task shorthand: one <task> = one run <task> (built-ins take precedence)
Command help: one <command> --help

locale.tip:
Shows the saved language preference and the language active in this terminal. Pass auto, zh-CN, or en-US to change the preference.

auto follows LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES, then LANG; the fallback is English. The Dashboard shares this preference. Project and third-party tool logs keep their original language.
exec.tip:
Runs a command in the selected project directory. Select a project by name or relative path, or run from inside a project. The positional project and --project must agree when both are used.

Use -- to separate One options from the child command. When the workspace has an env binding, variables are fetched from Infisical and injected into the child process. --env selects the environment. Injected values override same-name shell variables. Without a binding, or for a disabled project, the shell environment is used directly. Local .env files are not loaded by One.

With --global, provide --env and --path explicitly. The command keeps the current working directory. Use --keys to select shared credentials.

Known injected secret values are masked on stdout and stderr.
serve.tip:
Starts a local Dashboard for workspaces, development services, project configuration, Infisical login, and shared credentials. The project Run tab provides start, stop, restart, a live console, and local access links. Review manifest changes before saving. Plaintext variables are fetched only when viewed or copied.

By default, binds to 127.0.0.1 on an available port and opens your browser. Closing the page keeps services running; Ctrl-C stops the Dashboard and its services. Host and Origin checks protect the interface.

tasks.dynamic_config: Task %s needs dynamic configuration or structured dependencies; static planning cannot determine its execution scope.
tasks.multi_arguments: Pass task arguments to one project at a time.
tasks.missing: Task %s was not found. Run one run to list available tasks.
tasks.output_escape: Task %s declares an output outside its directory: %s.
tasks.output_conflict: Tasks %s and %s write overlapping output directories.
tasks.preview: Static preview only; cache hits have not been calculated.
tasks.context_required: Task context is missing. Run one run %s -p %s through One.
tasks.context_invalid: The One task context is invalid or belongs to another workspace.
tasks.context_changed: Project %s changed after task preparation. Run the task again.
tasks.tui_unavailable: Task output supports stream and raw. Use --ui stream or --ui raw.
tasks.raw_cache_off: Raw output disables task artifact caching for this run.
tasks.one_name: Use one run <task> [-p project] -- [arguments]. For an arbitrary command, use one exec.
tasks.run.short: Run named workspace tasks with mise
tasks.run.long: Lists tasks with no arguments. Runs root tasks or selected project tasks with their dependencies. one <task> is shorthand for one run <task>, including dev, build, test, and lint. Built-in commands take precedence; use one run <task> for a conflicting name.
tasks.flag.cache: Cache access: local-only, read-write, read-only, write-only, off
tasks.flag.concurrency: Maximum parallel tasks (dev allocates automatically when omitted)
tasks.flag.force: Bypass freshness checks; combine with --cache off to ensure execution
tasks.flag.dry_run: Preview tasks without preparing tools, dependencies, secrets, or caches
tasks.cache_context_required: Task %s enables artifact caching without the One environment fingerprint. Add one __task-input to cache.command_inputs in mise.toml.
tasks.directory_override: Generated task %s must run in project directory %s. Remove its dir override, or define a custom run command.
tasks.dev_exclusive: Development task %s requires exclusive terminal access. Run it separately with -p, or remove interactive/raw for concurrent services.
tasks.dev_raw_multiple: --ui raw supports one development service. Use --ui stream for multiple services.
tasks.dev_concurrency: These development tasks require at least %d concurrent slots. Omit --concurrency for automatic allocation.
tasks.reserved_argument: Task arguments cannot contain ::: because mise reserves it to separate tasks.
manifest.domains_removed: The domains field has been removed. Move Infisical domains.env.config to env and project domains.env to project env. Remove dotenv configuration and move project domains.dev to dev. Existing files are unchanged.

miseconfig.trust_failed: Could not trust generated mise configuration %s: %w. Review it and run one mise trust %q.
creation.mise_trust_warning: Files were created, but automatic mise trust did not complete: %s
env.set_syntax_conflict: Use either KEY=VALUE or KEY VALUE, without combining the two forms.
devservice.closed: The service manager is shutting down.
devservice.limit: Too many services are running. Stop a service first.
devservice.url_invalid: Use a local HTTP(S) URL without credentials, query parameters, or fragments.
devservice.interactive: This dev task needs an interactive terminal. Run one dev in an external console.
devservice.unavailable: The service manager is unavailable. Restart one serve.
devservice.forget_active: Stop this workspace’s development services before removing it from the list.
